Name: Hatchet Mod
Author: ponderosaMods
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The Hatchet replaces your pickaxe with a single multi-purpose tool that chops wood and breaks rocks. No more swapping between axe and pickaxe — the Hatchet does it all. The axe remains in your inventory as usual; only the pickaxe slot is replaced. The Hatchet even has two poses: a wood-cutting sprite when swinging at trees and logs, and a rock-breaking sprite when swinging at stone and ore. Upgrade it at Clint's just like a normal pickaxe.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI                                                                                                                                                                                            2. Download and unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
3. Launch the game through SMAPI                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ▎ Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu to toggle the mod on/off from the in-game options menu.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
- One tool, two jobs : the Hatchet chops trees and breaks rocks at the correct efficiency for its upgrade level                                        
- Two sprites : swings with a wood-cutting pose when targeting trees, logs, and stumps; switches to a rock-breaking pose for stone and ore
- Upgradeable at Clint's — copper, steel, gold, and iridium tiers, each requiring 8 bars at 150% of the standard gold cost                      
- New game support — both the starting axe and pickaxe are removed; you start with a Basic Hatchet instead                                      
- Existing save support — installing mid-playthrough replaces your pickaxe with a Hatchet at the same upgrade level; your axe is untouched                                                                                                                                                                                                   
- Safe to disable — toggling the mod off replaces the Hatchet with a Pickaxe of the same level; new-game saves also have a Basic Axe restored       

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- SMAPI 4.0 or later                                                                                                                                                                                    [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Stardew Valley 1.6 or later                          [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional — for the in-game enable/disable toggle)  [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Inspired by the Hatchet in Story of Seasons: The Grand Bazaar, which first showed me how satisfying it is to clear a field without juggling tools. Thanks to the SMAPI and Harmony teams for making Stardew modding as accessible as it is. Coding Assistance by Claude.
